_meta.description: Importer dependence on oil routes. Only figures that a cited source states directly are included. Per-country shares of each route's flow are NOT published by EIA and are NOT invented here.
what_is_missing: Per-country shares for Hormuz (EIA gives only a four-country combined share)
Any destination breakdown for Bab el-Mandeb, Suez, Turkish Straits, Danish Straits
Strategic petroleum reserve days of cover per country (not sourced yet; IEA/EIA stock data would be needed)
_meta.comtrade_note: UN Comtrade would add bilateral crude import values by country, which could give true per-country shares of Gulf-origin crude. It needs a (free, rate-limited) subscription key and reports trade by origin and destination country, not by chokepoint, so route shares would still be inferred. Not used in M1.
